A path toward service

Ordinary rank advancement does not require a profession of Christian faith. Leadership carries additional expectations for Christian faith and biblical maturity.

RankRequirementsExpectationsPermissions
PeonFamily-friendly name.Follow the Community Rules.Speak in guild chat.
FarmerJoin Discord and connect Discord to Battle.net.Continue following the Community Rules.As above.
SquireGuild member for 2 weeks; download Guild Fellowship; active communication or involvement in guild activities.Participate in the community.As above.
KnightSquire for 2 weeks; display good character.Be willing to invite members when asked.Invite members.
StewardKnight for 2 weeks; volunteer to steward the guild bank.Be a good steward of guild resources.Additional guild bank permissions.
VeteranKnight or Steward for 2 weeks; volunteer to lead activities. Depending on the role, testimony and Statement of Faith approval may be required.Lead respectfully and maintain positive relationships with members and Officers.Withdraw gold.
ModeratorKnight, Steward, or Veteran for 2 weeks; share testimony; affirm Statement of Faith; volunteer to moderate.Protect the community and refer issues to Officers when needed.Demote or remove members.
OfficerModerator for 2 weeks.Participate in Officer meetings and decision making; help shape the guild.Officer status, promotions, and bank tab management.
Guild Master—Tie breaker.Officer status, promotions, and bank tab management.
PurgatoryNone.Restricted status used for moderation and further Officer intervention.None.

Questions about your next step? Talk with an Officer about the requirements and ways you can contribute.
